title: Potential performance issue
detail: Using `type(value) in _SCALAR_TYPES` can be slower than using `isinstance(value, _SCALAR_TYPES)` because it involves a dictionary lookup.
note: type() in a set is the faster check, which is what the PR is for.

title: Potential race condition
detail: Checking if the lock is not locked before acquiring it can lead to a race condition where another coroutine might acquire the lock between the check and the acquire call.
note: Twisted runs on one thread, so nothing takes the lock between the check and acquire(); not about the dropped await.
